name: MV.tech Solutions
summary: MV.tech Solutions is a software development, data engineering and AI services company headquartered in Bellerose, New York, USA, with an office in Ahmedabad, India. Founded in 2022, it builds business applications, data platforms, reporting systems, AI integrations and automated workflows. Services include project delivery, dedicated engineering teams, IT staff augmentation and technology recruitment for clients in the USA and worldwide, with collaboration hours agreed per engagement.
shortSummary: Software development, data engineering, BI and AI services from our US headquarters in New York and our office in Ahmedabad, India.
disambiguation: The software, data and AI engineering company at mvtech.solutions, founded by Meet Vaghasia in 2022. Not affiliated with other businesses that use the name MV Tech.
